01 · Gold basics

Start making gold, step by step

1

Weekly gold raids

Press P to check your item level, then Alt+Q to choose your raids. Clear three different gold raids per gold earner, up to six characters. Choose your best Group or Solo lineup.

Find your raid lineup →

2

Life Skills & crafting

Burn your shared Life Energy with fishing, excavating, logging or another Life Skill. Sell the tradeable materials, or use LoA Buddy to check whether crafting a finished item is more profitable. Choose one product and fill your Stronghold crafting slots.

Farming locations → · Crafting calculator →

3

Field Boss / Chaos Gate

Check Procyon’s Compass for today’s Field Boss or Chaos Gate. Kill Sevek Atun for tradeable drops and Loot Auction gold, or run your highest eligible Chaos Gate and claim its gold reward. Each uses its roster reward limit.

Check your daily routine →

Understand the gold you earn

Tradeable gold

Use it on the Market, Auction House and eligible player trades. Raid gold, sales and crafting profit can feed this balance.

Roster-bound gold

Use it for eligible honing and progression costs on characters in your roster. It cannot be spent on the Market or Auction House.

Character-bound gold

Use it for eligible progression costs on the character that earned it. Gold from Cathedral and Paradise stays on that character.

Bound materials cannot be sold and do not increase your gold balance. Sell only items whose tooltips and trade count allow listing.
◇Optional loot sales: what to check

Raid clear gold, Life Skill materials and profitable crafting are your starting point. Accessory refinement and bracelet rolls can produce valuable items, but rolling costs gold and good results are random. Check the item’s trade eligibility and compare its sale price with the rolling costs before spending.

Recognize tradeable rewards

Examples of Tier 4 loot worth checking before auto-dismantling. Bound and tradeable versions can share the same icon—read the tooltip.

Destruction Stones

Sell the tradeable weapon-stone stacks.

Guardian Stones

Sell the tradeable armour-stone stacks.

Great Destiny Leapstones

Check the item’s binding before listing.

Destiny Shard Pouches

Tradeable pouches can be sold; loose shards cannot.

Tier 4 gems

Compare selling the gem with fusing three into a higher level.

Engraving books

Check the engraving, rarity and whether the book is tradeable.

Clear your weekly gold raids first. Earn more through Life Skills and profitable Stronghold crafting, then do the Field Boss or Chaos Gate on its scheduled days. Treat rare drops and profitable accessory or bracelet rolls as extra income.

03 · Dailies & weeklies

Your gold-making routine

Run the content for your character’s item level. Life Energy and scheduled reward limits are shared across your roster.

PER CHARACTER

Dailies

At 1750+, use Stage 2 of Chaos Rift and Guardian’s Shade. Run dailies every day or with Rest Bonus to fit your schedule.

ON COMPASS DAYS

Scheduled content

Check Procyon’s Compass for today’s timers and remaining rewards. Swapping characters does not reset roster reward limits.

BEFORE WEEKLY RESET

Weeklies

Thaemine G4 has a two-week lockout. Event deadlines and Paradise season-end rewards are separate from the weekly raid reset.

04 · Locations and instructions

Where to go and what to do

Follow these instructions to reach the content and claim or sell its rewards.

Raid hub

Pick three gold raids

Alt+Q → choose a raid → inspect Gold Reward → Solo / Matching / Find Party.

  1. Check the entry level and your weekly gold slots.
  2. Clear each gate and claim its gold.
  3. Buy View More only when you need the materials or expect worthwhile loot.
  4. Keep valuable tradeable loot; subtract all spending from the payout.

At 1700+, Cathedral contributes a large character-bound payout to group lineups. Green amounts in the weekly table show how much you can use on the Market.

Life Skills: six professions, shared Life Energy

Press L to check your equipped tools, then B to switch to Trade Skills. Use the routes below for current T4 materials once you have access to those continents.

Fishing

Abidos Solar Carp

Abidos Garrison · North Kurzan

Stand at a fishing spot and use Float Fishing.

Excavating

Abidos Relic

Use Sonar, then Relic Search; dig at the revealed node.

Hunting

Seuht Valley · North Kurzan, or Yan’s Path · Rimeria

Foraging

Abidos Wild Flower

Abidos Garrison · North Kurzan, or Yan’s Path · Rimeria

Interact with flower nodes.

Logging

Abidos Timber

South Rimeria → Yan’s Path

Follow the tree nodes through the zone. Use this as your main logging route.

Mining

Abidos Iron Ore

Seuht Valley · North Kurzan, or Nukman Valley · South Rimeria

Maps show zone layouts. Open M in-game for the active resource nodes, triports and boss marker. Nodes can be occupied or depleted; change route or channel if necessary.

Raw materials and crafted output are two uses of the same gathering session. Compare both; count whichever you actually sell once. All six professions can feed current Abidos fusion recipes.

Farming Adventurer’s Tome collectibles

1

Choose an item

Open N → a continent’s collectible row. Find the exact tradeable collectible in the Market. Check recent sales and volume.

2

Run a short test

Rethramis beginner example: try Ankumo Mountain or Rethramis Border enemies. Keep duplicate collectible drops for sale. Cooking ingredients are separate and often bound.

3

Keep the better farm

Record net sales and time. If drops or demand are weak, switch continents or gather instead. Collection tokens, cards and island souls do not directly become gold.

The best farm is the one that sells at a worthwhile net return. After a 20-minute test, multiply net proceeds by three to estimate your own gold/hour. Keep random jackpots out of that estimate.

07 · Stronghold crafting

Stronghold crafting: choose your product

Fusion materials, battle items, food and other tradeable recipes compete for the same Workshop slots. Compare them, choose one profitable product, and fill your available slots.

CRAFTING PROFIT CALCULATOR

LoA Buddy

Compare recipes using your region’s prices and your Stronghold bonuses. Look for a positive profit after tax and a product buyers actually purchase.

OPEN CRAFTING CALCULATOR ↗loa-buddy.pages.dev/crafting · opens in a new tab
Profit (Taxed)Estimated net gold per craft after inputs, crafting cost and sale tax.
Profit/HourCompare how efficiently each recipe uses your Workshop time.
Selling PriceCheck the actual current output price. Empty or outdated prices can distort the result.
1

Set up your prices

Choose your region. Enter your Stronghold’s General and relevant category reductions for cost, time and Great Success. Sync prices and check them against your current Market listings.

2

Compare net profit

Check Profit (Taxed) and Profit/Hour. Enter the finished item’s realistic Selling Price. Compare only recipes still available in your Workshop; calculator lists can retain older recipes.

3

Fill your slots

Choose one product with a positive margin and enough buyers. Buy the inputs, queue your available slots, collect the output and sell it. Recheck prices before refilling.

Self-farmed materials have value because you can sell them. Count their raw sale proceeds or the finished item’s net result, never both. Count crafting profit separately from raid clear gold. Great Success and advertised sale prices do not guarantee a sale.

09 · Collection, milestone & season rewards

One-time & season-end gold rewards

These rewards sit outside your recurring raid gold. Claim collection and Express milestones once; Paradise ranking gold is paid at the end of its season.

Nukman’s Illusion Stones

30,000 bound gold · once per roster. Unlock the collection through the Rimeria adventure quest chain, collect 10 stones, then claim and open the gold chest from Sarta.

Open Collectibles → Nukman’s Illusion Stone for each stone’s hint and prerequisites. Some stones require Una reputation progress.

10 collected stones · permanent reward

Express gold rewards

Open Jump-Up Boost and Rapid Growth. Check the milestone rewards and nested boxes for gold bars, complete the required missions and claim your character’s rewards.

These events run until January 20, 2027; select a character by December 16, 2026. Each eligible gold milestone is claimed once.

Selected event character
